t_attribute.name: Week Beginning
t_attribute.description: Start day for mapping file data to weeks (0=automatic, 1-7=weekday, -1=hydro weeks)

t_attribute.name: Historical Sampling
t_attribute.description: Sample data from this file between the Year From and Year To

t_attribute.name: Historical Year From
t_attribute.description: First year read for historical sampling

t_attribute.name: Historical Year To
t_attribute.description: Last year read for historical sampling

t_attribute.name: Historical Year Start
t_attribute.description: Start year for historical sampling within the range Year From and Year To

t_attribute.name: Historical Year Ending
t_attribute.description: Month that years end in the historical data

t_attribute.name: Historical Period Type
t_attribute.description: Take samples at each of these period types

t_attribute.name: Base Year
t_attribute.description: Base year for mapping data from a file with month, day and period but no year

t_attribute.name: Suppress Rescaling
t_attribute.description: If rescaling should be suppressed in sampled chronology for this data file

t_attribute.name: Compound Type
t_attribute.description: Type of compound escalator (nominal or annual equivalent rate)

t_attribute.name: Compound Start Date
t_attribute.description: Start date for compounding index (-1 means use start of planning horizon)

t_attribute.name: Read Order
t_attribute.description: Order in which to read scenario data (last read scenario has highest priority)

t_attribute.name: Locked
t_attribute.description: If the Scenario data are locked for editing.

t_attribute.name: Enabled
t_attribute.description: If the model is ready to be executed

t_attribute.name: Execution Order
t_attribute.description: Order in which to execute the Model when running in a batch.

t_attribute.name: Random Number Seed
t_attribute.description: Random number seed for this model

t_attribute.name: Output to Folder
t_attribute.description: If model output should be written to a folder under the source directory, or into the source folder itself

t_attribute.name: Make Unique Name
t_attribute.description: If model output should be written to a unique filename for each execution

t_attribute.name: Write Input
t_attribute.description: If Model input should be written to the output location along with the solution.

t_attribute.name: Load Custom Assemblies
t_attribute.description: If the Model should run custom OpenPLEXOS assemblies.

t_attribute.name: Run Mode
t_attribute.description: Switches between Normal and Dry run modes

t_attribute.name: Objective Priority
t_attribute.description: Priority of the objective when doing hierarchical multi-objective optimization

t_attribute.name: Objective Weight
t_attribute.description: Weight of the objective when doing blended multi-objective optimization

t_attribute.name: Objective Relative Tolerance

t_attribute.name: Objective Absolute Tolerance
t_attribute.description: Allowable degradation for the objective when doing hierarchical multi-objective optimization for MIP models

t_attribute.name: Enabled
t_attribute.description: If the project is enabled for execution

t_attribute.name: Periods per Day
t_attribute.description: Number of intervals in each trading day

t_attribute.name: Compression Factor
t_attribute.description: Number of intervals to output per interval simulated

t_attribute.name: Date From
t_attribute.description: Start date of the planning horizon

t_attribute.name: Step Type
t_attribute.description: Planning horizon step type

t_attribute.name: Step Count
t_attribute.description: Number of steps in the planning horizon

t_attribute.name: Look-ahead Count
t_attribute.description: Number of additional look-ahead steps in the planning horizon

t_attribute.name: Day Beginning
t_attribute.description: Start hour of the trading day

t_attribute.name: Week Beginning
t_attribute.description: Start day for weekly constraints

t_attribute.name: Year Ending
t_attribute.description: Last month of the fiscal year

t_attribute.name: Chronology
t_attribute.description: Type of chronology used

t_attribute.name: Chrono Date From
t_attribute.description: Start date for the chronological model

t_attribute.name: Chrono Period From
t_attribute.description: Start interval for the chronological model

t_attribute.name: Chrono Period To
t_attribute.description: End interval for the chronological model

t_attribute.name: Chrono Step Type
t_attribute.description: Chronological model step type

t_attribute.name: Chrono At a Time
t_attribute.description: Number of steps in the chronological model

t_attribute.name: Chrono Step Count
t_attribute.description: Number of step types in each step of the chronological model

t_attribute.name: Look-ahead Indicator
t_attribute.description: Flag if chronological model used a look-ahead

t_attribute.name: Look-ahead Type
t_attribute.description: Step type for look-ahead in chronological model

t_attribute.name: Look-ahead At a Time
t_attribute.description: Number of step types in each step of the chronological model look-ahead

t_attribute.name: Look-ahead Periods per Day
t_attribute.description: Number of intervals in each trading day of the look-ahead

t_attribute.name: Write Flat Files
t_attribute.description: If the solution data are written to plain text files

t_attribute.name: Write XML Files
t_attribute.description: If the solution data are written to XML files

t_attribute.name: XML Content
t_attribute.description: Content of the zipped-XML solution files. Compact writes only binary solution tables. Raw writes binary and raw XML solution tables.

t_attribute.name: Output Results by Period
t_attribute.description: If results are written by period

t_attribute.name: Output Results by Hour
t_attribute.description: If summary results are written by hour

t_attribute.name: Output Results by Day
t_attribute.description: If summary results are written by day

t_attribute.name: Output Results by Week
t_attribute.description: If summary results are written by week

t_attribute.name: Output Results by Month
t_attribute.description: If summary results are written by month

t_attribute.name: Output Results by Quarter
t_attribute.description: If summary results are written by Quarter

t_attribute.name: Output Results by Fiscal Year
t_attribute.description: If summary results are written by year

t_attribute.name: Output Statistics
t_attribute.description: If statistics are calculated on multi-sample results

t_attribute.name: Output Results by Sample
t_attribute.description: If each sample is output

t_attribute.name: Filter Objects By Interval
t_attribute.description: If the selection of objects reported on applies to interval output

t_attribute.name: Filter Objects In Summary
t_attribute.description: If the selection of objects reported on applies to summary output

t_attribute.name: Whole Years Only
t_attribute.description: If reporting should be on whole years only

t_attribute.name: Datetime Convention
t_attribute.description: Convention used when writing DATETIME.

t_attribute.name: Locale
t_attribute.description: The numeric index of the locale that should be used to write text files.

t_attribute.name: Flat File Format
t_attribute.description: Format for text solution files.

t_attribute.name: Outage Pattern Count
t_attribute.description: Number of outage patterns generated for use in MT and ST Schedule.

t_attribute.name: Monte Carlo Method
t_attribute.description: Monte-Carlo outage method.

t_attribute.name: Weibull Shape
t_attribute.description: Shape parameter (beta) for the Weibull reliability function.

t_attribute.name: Convergent Smoothing
t_attribute.description: Convergent Monte Carlo number of iterations used in converging outage rates.

t_attribute.name: Outage Scope
t_attribute.description: Scope of preschedule outage pattern generator.

t_attribute.name: Convergence Period Type
t_attribute.description: Convergent Monte Carlo convergence period type.

t_attribute.name: Risk Sample Count
t_attribute.description: Number of random samples generated on each Variable object.

t_attribute.name: Reduced Outage Pattern Count
t_attribute.description: Statistically reduce the outage patterns to at most this number.

t_attribute.name: Reduced Sample Count
t_attribute.description: Statistically reduce the [Risk Sample Count] to at most this number of random samples for use in simulation.

t_attribute.name: Reduction Relative Accuracy
t_attribute.description: Stop sample reduction when the accuracy of the reduced sample set drops to this level.

t_attribute.name: Forced Outages in Look-ahead
t_attribute.description: If forced outages are included in the look-ahead.

t_attribute.name: EFOR Maintenance Adjust
t_attribute.description: Adjust EFOR to account for Units Out

t_attribute.name: SDDP Iteration Limit
t_attribute.description: Maximum number of iterations in SDDP algorithm

t_attribute.name: SDDP Convergence Tolerance 1
t_attribute.description: Objective function convergence criteria 1 for SDDP

t_attribute.name: SDDP Convergence Tolerance 2
t_attribute.description: Objective function convergence criteria 2 for SDDP

t_attribute.name: SDDP Convergence Tolerance 2a
t_attribute.description: Objective function convergence criteria 2 (with adjustment) used in SDDP if simplification applies

t_attribute.name: SDDP Cut Sharing
t_attribute.description: Type of cut sharing applied in the SDDP formulation

t_attribute.name: SDDP Simplified Chronology
t_attribute.description: If the chronology is simplified to one block per stage during SDDP iterations

t_attribute.name: SDDP Head Effects
t_attribute.description: If head effects are accounted for in SDDP iterations

t_attribute.name: SDDP Warm Start
t_attribute.description: If the first forward pass of SDDP is replaced by fixed 'warm start' storage levels

t_attribute.name: SDDP Warm Start Level
t_attribute.description: The levels to fix the storage in SDDP 'warm start' as a proportion of the distance between minimum and maximum storage levels

t_attribute.name: SDDP Replace Samples
t_attribute.description: If the full branch samples in rolling horizon or the forward pass samples in SDDP should be replaced by user-defined samples

t_attribute.name: SDDP Final Pass Enabled
t_attribute.description: If a final forward pass is run after the optimal policy iterations of the SDDP algorithm

t_attribute.name: FCF Scalar
t_attribute.description: Scalar for future cost function objective and constraint terms

t_attribute.name: FCF Constant
t_attribute.description: Constant future cost subtracted from the future cost during SDDP iterations

t_attribute.name: Simplified Chronology
t_attribute.description: If the chronology is simplified to one block per stage during Rolling Horizon iterations

t_attribute.name: Simplify Hanging Branches After Branching
t_attribute.description: If hanging branches are simplified in detail after branching

t_attribute.name: Simplify Hanging Branches Before Branching
t_attribute.description: If hanging branches are simplified in detail before branching

t_attribute.name: Minimum Sample Weight
t_attribute.description: Minimum sample weight for rolling horizon iterations

t_attribute.name: Deep Branching
t_attribute.description: For Rolling Horizon this is the level of additional branching after the end of regular branching

t_attribute.name: Rolling Horizon With Other Variables
t_attribute.description: Perform historical sampling for all variable types

t_attribute.name: Rolling Stage Increment
t_attribute.description: Number of stages rolled forward each iteration where -1 means this is automatically determined based on the scenario tree

t_attribute.name: Rolling Lookahead
t_attribute.description: Number of years modeled after the end of branching in each rolling iteration

t_attribute.name: Deterministic Pass Enabled
t_attribute.description: If the final deterministic pass is run after iterations of the Rolling Horizon algorithm

t_attribute.name: Deterministic Step Type
t_attribute.description: The step type for solving the final deterministic pass of the rolling horizon where "None" solves the entire horizon in one step

t_attribute.name: Deterministic Batch Count
t_attribute.description: For Deterministic Step Type = "None" the samples in the deterministic phase will be divided into this number of batches

t_attribute.name: Deterministic Step Length
t_attribute.description: The number of Deterministic Step Type periods in each step of the deterministic pass of the rolling horizon

t_attribute.name: PARMA Model Type
t_attribute.description: PARMA Model Type (-1 = None, 0 = SARIMA model, 1 = PARMA model)

t_attribute.name: Historical Full Branches
t_attribute.description: Flag if full branches should be mapped by historical data in the PARMA model

t_attribute.name: Brazil Scenario Tree
t_attribute.description: Flag if the PARMA scenario tree is created with non-equiprobability

t_attribute.name: SDDP Resampling
t_attribute.description: Flag if resampling is performed for each SDDP iteration at the beginning of the forward pass (The Scenario Tree must be created with PARMA model using Brazilian Methodology)

t_attribute.name: Optimize Expansion
t_attribute.description: If expansion is optimized by this simulation phase

t_attribute.name: Bridge Constraints
t_attribute.description: If LT Plan should bridge (decompose) constraints for subsequent simulation phases

t_attribute.name: Bridge Storage
t_attribute.description: If LT Plan should bridge (decompose) storage for subsequent simulation phases

t_attribute.name: Discount Rate
t_attribute.description: Discount rate.

t_attribute.name: Discount Period Type
t_attribute.description: A unique discount factor and expansion decisions will be computed for each of these periods.

t_attribute.name: At a Time
t_attribute.description: Number of years solved in each step of LT Plan

t_attribute.name: Overlap
t_attribute.description: Number of years overlap between steps where -1 invokes Rolling Horizon

t_attribute.name: Chronology
t_attribute.description: Type of chronology used

t_attribute.name: LDC Type
t_attribute.description: One LDC is created for each period of this type in horizon.

t_attribute.name: Block Count
t_attribute.description: Number of load duration curve blocks in each day/week/month.

t_attribute.name: Last Block Count
t_attribute.description: Number of load duration curve blocks in the last load duration curve of the horizon, or zero if the same as [Block Count].

t_attribute.name: LDC Slicing Method
t_attribute.description: Method used to slice the LDC into blocks.

t_attribute.name: LDC Weight a
t_attribute.description: LDC weighting polynomial function 'a' parameter.

t_attribute.name: LDC Weight b
t_attribute.description: LDC weighting polynomial function 'b' parameter.

t_attribute.name: LDC Weight c
t_attribute.description: LDC weighting polynomial function 'c' parameter.

t_attribute.name: LDC Weight d
t_attribute.description: LDC weighting polynomial function 'd' parameter.

t_attribute.name: LDC Pin Top
t_attribute.description: Number of points at the top of the LDC that are pinned and cannot be aggregated into blocks.

t_attribute.name: LDC Pin Bottom
t_attribute.description: Number of points at the bottom of the LDC that are pinned and cannot be aggregated into blocks.

t_attribute.name: Sample Type
t_attribute.description: For Chronology = "Sampled", take this type of sample.

t_attribute.name: Sampling Interval
t_attribute.description: For Chronology = "Sampled", take [Sample Type] samples in each of these intervals of time.

t_attribute.name: Sampled Block Count
t_attribute.description: Number of blocks modeled in each sample period (day/week) where zero means the original number of intervals

t_attribute.name: Sample Year Count
t_attribute.description: For [Chronology] = "Sampled", first select this many years then sample within only those years.

t_attribute.name: Reduced Sample Count
t_attribute.description: Statistically reduce the [Sample Type] periods to at most this number of samples each year.

t_attribute.name: Reduction Relative Accuracy
t_attribute.description: Stop sample reduction when the accuracy of the reduced sample set reaches this level.

t_attribute.name: Sampled Shallow Storage Treatment
t_attribute.description: For Chronology = "Sampled", method used for formulating low duration storages and batteries

t_attribute.name: Sampled Shallow Storage Cutoff
t_attribute.description: For [Chronology] = "Sampled" and [Sampled Shallow Storage Treatment] = "Custom", the maximum storage duration in hours for the shallow storage formulation to apply.

t_attribute.name: Decomposition
t_attribute.description: Reduce the number of simulated periods by this factor in the first pass of a two-pass decomposition

t_attribute.name: Optimality
t_attribute.description: LT Plan integerization scheme.

t_attribute.name: Integerization Horizon
t_attribute.description: Number of years over which the expansion decisions are integerized

t_attribute.name: End Effects Method
t_attribute.description: Method used to account for end of horizon effects

t_attribute.name: Limit Capital Cost Perpetuity by Economic Life
t_attribute.description: With perpetuity end effect, if annuity calculation should extend beyond the end of the horizon up to the Economic Life

t_attribute.name: Solution Count
t_attribute.description: Maximum number of solutions produced in the solution hierarchy

t_attribute.name: Solution Quality
t_attribute.description: Continue producing solutions up to Solution Count or when Solution Quality falls to this level

t_attribute.name: Always Annualize Build Cost
t_attribute.description: If [Build Cost] is always annualized even when an option retires inside the horizon

t_attribute.name: Depreciation Method
t_attribute.description: Depreciation method for computing annuities

t_attribute.name: Tax Rate
t_attribute.description: Tax rate used to compute tax credits

t_attribute.name: Inflation Rate
t_attribute.description: Inflation rate used in depreciation calculations

t_attribute.name: Heat Rate Detail
t_attribute.description: Level of detail for Generator heat rate modelling.

t_attribute.name: Outage Increment
t_attribute.description: Generator outage bin size in convolution

t_attribute.name: Use Effective Load Approach
t_attribute.description: If LT Plan uses the effective load approach

t_attribute.name: Maintenance Sculpting
t_attribute.description: If LT Plan should sculpt maintenance derating according to the inverse of load.

t_attribute.name: Maintenance Rate Output Basis
t_attribute.description: Basis for Maintenance Rate (%) Output due to Maintenance Sculpting.

t_attribute.name: Pricing Method
t_attribute.description: Type of generator pricing used in LT Plan.

t_attribute.name: Transmission Detail
t_attribute.description: Level of detail used in transmission modelling in LT Plan.

t_attribute.name: Allow Capacity Sharing
t_attribute.description: If regions/zones can share capacity reserves to meet requirements

t_attribute.name: Capacity Payments Enabled
t_attribute.description: If payments are made for generation capacity

t_attribute.name: Co-optimize Unit Commitment
t_attribute.description: If unit commitment is co-optimized rather than sequentially optimized with expansion

t_attribute.name: Start Cost Amortization Period
t_attribute.description: Number of hours over which generator start costs are amortized

t_attribute.name: Compute Reliability Indices
t_attribute.description: Master switch for computation of reliability indices LOLP, LOLE, etc.

t_attribute.name: Compute Multi-area Reliability Indices
t_attribute.description: Master switch for computation of reliability indices LOLP, LOLE, etc across multiple areas.

t_attribute.name: Stochastic Method
t_attribute.description: Stochastic optimization method for LT Plan

t_attribute.name: Storage Restart
t_attribute.description: If recycled storage should restart from their initial volume at the start of each capacity optimization period

t_attribute.name: Storage Formulate Head Effects
t_attribute.description: If storage head effects should be formulated in LT Plan

t_attribute.name: Write Expansion Plan Text Files
t_attribute.description: If expansion plans should be written to text files

t_attribute.name: Step Type
t_attribute.description: PASA step type: One period is modelled for each period of this type in horizon.

t_attribute.name: Transmission Detail
t_attribute.description: Definition of maintenance area for PASA.

t_attribute.name: Include DSP
t_attribute.description: Include demand-side participation in PASA

t_attribute.name: Include Demand Bids
t_attribute.description: Include demand bids are load in PASA

t_attribute.name: Include Contract Generation
t_attribute.description: Include physical contract generation capacity in PASA

t_attribute.name: Include Contract Load
t_attribute.description: Include physical contract load capacity in PASA

t_attribute.name: Include Market Purchases
t_attribute.description: Include market purchases as generation capacity in PASA

t_attribute.name: Constraints Enabled
t_attribute.description: If transmission line constraints are enabled in PASA.

t_attribute.name: Interface Constraints Enabled
t_attribute.description: If transmission interface constraints are enabled in PASA.

t_attribute.name: Maintenance Sculpting
t_attribute.description: Level of sculpting of maintenance outages: Higher sculpting means outages are more concentrated in high reserve periods

t_attribute.name: Compute Reliability Indices
t_attribute.description: Master switch for computation of reliability indices LOLP, LOLE, etc.

t_attribute.name: Compute Multi-area Reliability Indices
t_attribute.description: Master switch for computation of reliability indices LOLP, LOLE, etc across multiple areas.

t_attribute.name: Reliability Criterion
t_attribute.description: Criterion used to select periods for Monte Carlo reliability analysis

t_attribute.name: Reliability LOLP Tolerance
t_attribute.description: For reliability-based sampled chronology using LOLP criterion select intervals with LOLP at or above this level

t_attribute.name: Reliability Max Samples
t_attribute.description: For reliability-based sampled chronology select no more than this many hours per year

t_attribute.name: Write Reliability Text Files
t_attribute.description: If the periods selected for Monte Carlo reliability analysis should be written to text files

t_attribute.name: Write Outage Text Files
t_attribute.description: If outage patterns should be written to text files

t_attribute.name: Energy Objective
t_attribute.description: Relative contribution of energy margins to PASA objective function

t_attribute.name: Stochastic Method
t_attribute.description: Stochastic optimization method for PASA.

t_attribute.name: Discount Rate
